note: One baked take in FBX/GLB (master timeline). Unity: split into clips by these frame ranges; loop=true clips are seamless.

clips.name: Charge
clips.desc: energy build-up: emitter deploys 25 mm, coils light rear -> front (cadence 2.4 s = Charge + Fire + Cool)

clips.name: Fire
clips.desc: shot: arc + flash 2 f, coils dump, rails recoil 40 mm

clips.name: Cool
clips.desc: rails run out, vent flaps open 60 deg, emitter retracts, flaps close

gameplay: Animation is visual only: it adds no gameplay capability, shot count or timing authority.
